mapper.select: SELECT ub.id, ub.user_id, u.user_id as uid, u.nickname, u.avatar_url, ub.blocked_user_id, u2.user_id as blocked_user_uid, u2.nickname as blocked_user_nickname, u2.avatar_url as blocked_user_avatar_url, ub.create_time FROM user_blacklist as ub LEFT JOIN ani_sphere.user u ON ub.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN ani_sphere.user u2 ON ub.blocked_user_id = u2.id;

select ub.user_id as uid, ub.blocked_user_id as BlackUid, u.nickname as NickName, u.email as Email from user_blacklist as ub join ani_sphere.user u on u.id = ub.blocked_user_id where ub.user_id = '30';
